QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: currentAccuracy
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Receiver-reported base position accuracy. Unavailable accuracy is not inferred from a valid fix and cannot be saved as fixed-base accuracy.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: currentAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Base position altitude above the WGS84 ellipsoid, not mean sea level.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: numSatellites
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Satellites in the latest complete observation snapshot, or -1 when unavailable.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: numSatellitesUsed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Receiver-reported usage count or an exact count from known satellite usage flags; -1 when unavailable.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixType
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Latest fix reported by the receiver. Unknown when the receiver family does not report position in its current role.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Unknown,No Fix,2D Lock,3D Lock,3D DGPS Lock,3D RTK GPS Lock (float),3D RTK GPS Lock (fixed),Extrapolated
